tagline: One of North America's largest and most diversified freight transportation companies
hero_kpi_rationale: KPI central because it reflects operational efficiency in a low-margin sector. The improvement from 94.7% to 94.1% demonstrates superior cost management despite a tight competitive environment.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company from selling its transportation services.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached 7.5 billion dollars in 2025, up slightly from 2024.
kpis.signal: Revenue stability despite a challenging environment.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after operating costs but before taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Operating income declined in 2025, falling from 243.4 million to 216.1 million dollars.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Ratio
kpis.explanation: Operating costs adjusted per dollar of revenue, lower is better.
kpis.description: The adjusted ratio improved from 94.7% in 2024 to 94.1% in 2025, indicating more efficient cost management.
kpis.signal: Improvement in operational efficiency after adjustments.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after adjustments for non-recurring items such as depreciation or exceptional losses.
kpis.description: Adjusted net income increased sharply, rising from 172.1 million to 204.7 million dollars.
kpis.signal: Significant adjusted profit growth despite lower gross results.

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS
kpis.explanation: Earnings per share after adjustments, used by investors.
kpis.description: Adjusted EPS increased from 1.06$ to 1.26$ between 2024 and 2025.
kpis.signal: Adjusted earnings per share growth despite sector volatility.

kpis.name: Tractors (Truckload)
kpis.explanation: Size of the truck fleet operated directly or through independent contractors.
kpis.description: In 2025, the average fleet consisted of 21,428 tractors, including 19,395 company-owned and 2,033 operated by independent contractors.
kpis.signal: Stable fleet reflecting a moderate growth strategy.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 11.96 billion euros in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 2.69 billion euros in the latest year.

kpis.name: Asset Impairments
kpis.explanation: Non-cash accounting losses on assets deemed less valued, notably for Abilene and real estate assets.
kpis.description: Impairments reached 98.3 million dollars in 2025 compared to 19.0 million in 2024, primarily related to the Abilene exit and real estate assets.
kpis.signal: Significant impairments in 2025 linked to strategic restructuring decisions.

kpis.name: Severance Expense
kpis.explanation: Costs of severance plans or restructuring related to operational optimization.
kpis.description: Severance expenses decreased from 7.2 million in 2024 to 3.0 million in 2025.
kpis.signal: Reduced restructuring costs in 2025 following completion of prior plans.

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattack risks due to its technology dependence and the sensitivity of data it processes. The language used in the report is intense and emphasizes the importance of cybersecurity.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector where businesses must constantly innovate and improve services to remain competitive. The report mentions increased competition in the sector.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the transportation sector, and any regulatory changes could negatively impact its operations. The report emphasizes the importance of regulatory compliance.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology for its operations, and any malfunction or interruption could negatively impact its activities. The report stresses the importance of technology in the company's operations.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks due to the sensitivity of services it offers and the importance of customer trust. The report emphasizes the importance of reputation in the sector.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financial risks due to its debt dependence and financial market volatility. The report mentions financial risks related to debt and financial markets.

ai_positioning.summary: KNX does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report.
